methodology.purpose: Identify mechanically valid but semantically weak, over-saturated, under-interacted, or statistically unusual generated sites.
methodology.note: Review findings are tuning signals, not topology failures. Explicitly unusual worldbuilding combinations remain legal.

recommendations.reason: 4 cases show strong historical pressure with little or no explicit adaptation.
recommendations.action: Add interaction rules for the specific controller/archetype/ecology combinations listed by the flagged cases; do not add generic random rooms.
Audit whether connector entries represent intentional traversable shafts/stairs or repeated connector points; normalize only if they represent duplicate traversal semantics.
